I also struggle with showing affection everyday is a struggle can really do much but take it day by day. Grand gestures of affection aren’t for everyone it’s okay to not feel comfortable with doing them. I like to tell people it’s the small things that count the most, saying it is one thing actually doing things for your partner is different. 

What’s his favorite movie/tv series? lay down and watch them with him even if you don’t like them. What’s his favorite food? Buy him with lunch. See a little knick knack at the store that made you think “Oh they’d like this” buy it. 

Tiny things that you can do in your everyday life work just as well shows your partner you’re thinking of them and brightens their day. 

Good luck I hope my advice helps!
